sources.title: Motion Dynamics Learning for Few-Shot Embodied Adaptation
sources.snippet: In contrast, motion dynamics governing how actions evolve over time are more informative and transferable, making them better suited for few-shot adaptation. Motivated by this idea, we propose DynVLA, a few-shot adaptation system that reformulates VLA learning from action imitation to trajectory-level motion dynamics modeling.

sources.title: Motion Dynamics Learning for Few-Shot Embodied Adaptation
sources.snippet: DynVLA is designed as a dynamics-constrained model that achieves few-shot adaptation by conditioning action gen-eration on reusable motion-pattern prototypes. The model circumvents the need for extensive policy fine-tuning by leveraging a pretrained repository of trajectory-level execu-tion patterns.
